Archify scenario recipes (13)

Choose the question before the diagram type. Run: archify guide "your scenario"

system-overview  [architecture]  System overview
  What exists, who owns it, and how is it connected?
deployment-ownership  [architecture]  Deployment ownership
  Where does each workload run, and what crosses a boundary?
agent-tool-call  [workflow]  Agent tool-call loop
  How does an agent plan, get permission, act, recover, and report?
delivery-workflow  [workflow]  Delivery workflow
  How does a change move safely from commit to production?
incident-runbook  [workflow]  Incident runbook
  How do responders detect, triage, mitigate, verify, and escalate?
api-request  [sequence]  API request chain
  Who calls whom, in what order, and what returns?
async-roundtrip  [sequence]  Async roundtrip
  What happens after the initial request returns?
data-lineage  [dataflow]  Data lineage
  Where does data come from, how does it change, and who consumes it?
event-stream  [dataflow]  Event-stream topology
  Which events move through which topics, processors, groups, and failure paths?
object-lifecycle  [lifecycle]  Object lifecycle
  Which states exist, what events move between them, and how does it end?
deployment-lifecycle  [lifecycle]  Deployment lifecycle
  What state is a release in, and what can happen next?
database-schema  [erd]  Database schema
  Which tables exist, what columns and keys do they carry, and how do they relate?
layout-repair  [architecture]  Layout repair
  Why does the existing diagram overflow, overlap, or route through nodes, and what should be fixed first?
